notes: SUB-ACCOUNTS: an account can now have sub-accounts (Chart of Accounts, + Sub-account), and the Trial Balance, Income & Expenditure, Financial Position, Notes and Budget Control show each heading with its parts beneath it. Settings, Chart of Accounts: choose how deep the chart may nest and whether a heading can be posted to. BIGGER MONITORS: the User Guide fills the screen, and the window reopens where you left it, with its own zoom on each display. Carries everything in 0.8.136. Installing: one new migration adds the sub-account column; no account moves and no figure changes. Please take a backup first: Backup and Export, Back up now.
